questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements about Rule 8 (Connection with press or radio):
I. Previous sanction is required for a Government servant to own or conduct a newspaper.
II. No Government servant can participate in a radio broadcast without previous sanction, except in the bona fide discharge of duties.
III. A Government servant requires permission to publish a scientific paper in a recognized academic journal.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
options_english: I only
I and II only
II and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: According to Rule 8, previous sanction is indeed required for a Government servant to own or conduct a newspaper, and they cannot participate in a radio broadcast without prior permission, except while performing their official duties. However, the requirement for permission to publish a scientific paper in a recognized academic journal is not mandated by this rule. Therefore, statements I and II are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नियम 8 के अनुसार, एक सरकारी कर्मचारी के लिए एक समाचार पत्र का स्वामित्व या संचालन करने के लिए पूर्व अनुमति आवश्यक है, और वे अपने आधिकारिक कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन करते समय छोड़कर, पूर्व अनुमति के बिना रेडियो प्रसारण में भाग नहीं ले सकते। हालाँकि, एक मान्यता प्राप्त शैक्षणिक पत्रिका में एक वैज्ञानिक पत्र प्रकाशित करने के लिए अनुमति की आवश्यकता इस नियम द्वारा अनिवार्य नहीं है। इसलिए, बयान I और II सही हैं।
key_facts: Rule 8 mandates prior sanction for owning a newspaper.
Participation in radio broadcasts requires permission, except for official duties.
Printed answer key: (B) I and II only

questions.explanation_english: Rule 12 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 governs subscriptions and fund collection. It provides that no public servant shall, except with previous government sanction, ask for, accept, or participate in raising any financial contributions or other collections in pursuance of any object whatsoever, regardless of its purpose. This rule is crucial to maintain the integrity and impartiality of public servants in their official duties.

key_facts: Rule 5 prohibits public servants from political party membership.
Ensures political neutrality in public administration.

questions.question_english: A Government servant takes a loan from a relative. Which of the following conditions mandates that the transaction must be reported to the Government under Rule 16 (Lending and Borrowing)?
options_english: Taking loans from entities having official dealings is restricted.
The loan aggregate monetary value exceeds the monthly basic pay of the borrowing Government servant.
The lending relative holds foreign citizenship or is currently residing as a foreign national.
The loan constitutes a purely temporary financial advance of a small amount completely free of interest.
questions.explanation_english: Rule 16 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 restricts lending and borrowing activities. While purely temporary personal loans of small amounts from relatives without interest are permitted, borrowing from or entering into financial dealings with any person or entity having official dealings with the public servant is strictly restricted. Therefore, the correct answer is option A, as it highlights the restriction on loans from entities with official dealings.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। नियम 16 के तहत, केंद्रीय सिविल सेवाएं (आचरण) नियम, 1964 में उधारी और ऋण गतिविधियों पर प्रतिबंध लगाया गया है। जबकि बिना ब्याज के रिश्तेदारों से छोटे अस्थायी व्यक्तिगत ऋण की अनुमति है, किसी भी व्यक्ति या संस्था से उधार लेना या वित्तीय लेन-देन करना जो सार्वजनिक सेवक के साथ आधिकारिक लेन-देन में है, सख्ती से प्रतिबंधित है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प A है, क्योंकि यह आधिकारिक लेन-देन वाले संस्थाओं से ऋण पर प्रतिबंध को उजागर करता है।
key_facts: Rule 16 restricts lending and borrowing activities.
Temporary personal loans from relatives without interest are allowed.
Printed answer key: (A) Taking loans from entities having official dealings is restricted.

questions.question_english: Which of the following forms of protest is strictly prohibited for Government servants under Rule 7 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964?
options_english: Submitting a formal written representation regarding service grievances directly to the Head of Department
Resorting to or abetting any form of strike regarding service matters
Seeking a judicial remedy in an appropriate court of law or administrative tribunal for service matters
Filing a routine Right to Information application regarding official service conditions and departmental rules
questions.explanation_english: Rule 7 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964 explicitly prohibits public servants from engaging in or abetting any form of strike, demonstration, or mass work stoppage connected with service conditions. Employees retain the right to submit individual administrative representations or seek judicial remedies through legal forums and statutory tribunals.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नियम 7 के तहत, केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (आचार) नियम, 1964 सार्वजनिक कर्मचारियों को सेवा स्थितियों से संबंधित किसी भी प्रकार की हड़ताल, प्रदर्शन या सामूहिक कार्य रोकने में भाग लेने या उसका समर्थन करने से स्पष्ट रूप से रोकता है। कर्मचारियों को व्यक्तिगत प्रशासनिक प्रतिनिधित्व प्रस्तुत करने या कानूनी मंचों और वैधानिक न्यायाधिकरणों के माध्यम से न्यायिक उपाय मांगने का अधिकार है।
key_facts: Rule 7 prohibits strikes and demonstrations by government servants.
Employees can submit grievances through formal channels.
Printed answer key: (B) Resorting to or abetting any form of strike

questions.question_english: According to the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964, if a Government servant receives an oral direction from their official superior, what is the prescribed course of action?
options_english: The Government servant must outright refuse to execute any official order until it is formally issued in writing.
The Government servant shall seek written confirmation of the direction as early as possible.
The Government servant should execute the direction immediately.
The Government servant should ignore the oral instructions.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that the Government servant shall seek written confirmation of the direction as early as possible. Official directions should ordinarily be issued in writing to maintain clear administrative accountability. When a public servant receives oral instructions from an official superior, the employee is required to seek written confirmation of such directions as early as possible. Superior officers are similarly obligated to confirm oral orders in writing without undue delay.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सरकारी कर्मचारी को यथाशीघ्र निर्देश की लिखित पुष्टि प्राप्त करनी चाहिए। आधिकारिक निर्देशों को सामान्यतः लिखित रूप में जारी किया जाना चाहिए ताकि स्पष्ट प्रशासनिक जवाबदेही बनी रहे। जब एक सार्वजनिक कर्मचारी अपने आधिकारिक वरिष्ठ से मौखिक निर्देश प्राप्त करता है, तो कर्मचारी को ऐसे निर्देशों की लिखित पुष्टि यथाशीघ्र प्राप्त करनी चाहिए। वरिष्ठ अधिकारी भी बिना किसी अनावश्यक देरी के मौखिक आदेशों की लिखित पुष्टि करने के लिए बाध्य होते हैं।

questions.question_english: Under Rule 8 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964, previous sanction of the Government is not required for publishing a book if:
options_english: The book is published anonymously or under a pseudonymous name without declaring official identity
The book openly analyzes and criticizes current political policies and legislative decisions of the Government
It is of a purely literary, artistic or scientific character
The publication directly discusses sensitive administrative decisions and confidential departmental files
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 8 of the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, previous administrative sanction is not required if a published work is of a purely literary, artistic, or scientific character. However, this exemption applies provided the publication does not involve unauthorized use of confidential official information or express criticism of government policies.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 के नियम 8 के तहत, यदि प्रकाशित कार्य पूरी तरह से साहित्यिक, कलात्मक, या वैज्ञानिक स्वरूप का है, तो पूर्व प्रशासनिक अनुमति की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है। हालाँकि, यह छूट तब लागू होती है जब प्रकाशन में गोपनीय आधिकारिक जानकारी का अनधिकृत उपयोग या सरकारी नीतियों की स्पष्ट आलोचना शामिल न हो।
key_facts: Rule 8 exempts purely literary, artistic, or scientific works from prior sanction.
Exemption does not apply to unauthorized use of confidential information.
Printed answer key: (C) It is of a purely literary, artistic or scientific character.
